method: Re-read primary game design guidance against actual fixed-desktop screenshots and repository behavior; no competitor playtest

sources.title: Clarity in League
sources.observed: Visuals communicate gameplay, attention follows importance, and excessive effects reduce clarity.
sources.projectInference: Use one coherent game stage, emphasize the actual object and current decision, reduce repeated frames and keep ordinary feedback restrained.
sources.limit: Historical competitive-game design article; it does not prescribe this game's layout, online cycles, progression speed or balance.

sources.title: Xbox Accessibility Guideline 102: Contrast
sources.observed: Text, symbols, controls and notifications must remain distinguishable against their actual backgrounds; backing panels are one available technique.
sources.projectInference: Give the scene seal and short notification a stable opaque backing; keep persistent result text readable from its first frame, with decoration in a separate safe area.
sources.limit: No accessibility certification or whole-game contrast acceptance is claimed; all compatibility and environment matrices remain paused.

actualLocalGaps: Repeated full-width frames and equal emphasis make catalogue pages look like software forms.
The locked furnace has an empty panel; the selected relic is visually subordinate to a generic alchemy furnace.
The previous short victory notification crosses battle view controls; the closing motif reaches the life tabs or reading area.
An injured prepared spirit cultivator is directed toward the terrace before recovery; recent SOURCE/BUY/CRAFT feedback can override the current recovery or cultivation-cap stage.
assetApproach: Reuse existing generated paintings and established DOM/SVG object icons. No new raster asset, duplicate asset workflow or expanded existing budget is needed for this item.
followup: U8-B must separately verify actual per-realm resource/time tradeoffs and current idle-version normal full routes. Pure model timing from the initial audit is a lead, not human pacing or balance acceptance. U8-C and real user feedback retain their own evidence obligations.
status: Research applied to U8-A implementation; final execution and delivery are recorded separately in that item's verification evidence.
